changelog: Shorthand dates now land on the day you meant. Asking for something like "Aug 13, Thur, 10am" used to schedule tomorrow instead of the date you said. Abbreviated months and weekdays ("Aug", "Sept", "Thur", "Weds"), ordinals ("August 13th"), day-first dates ("13 Aug"), and dates that have already passed this year now all work. And when a date can't be read at all, the app asks you which day you meant instead of quietly booking tomorrow.
